sources.title: 2025—2026年小麦（三等）最低收购价每50公斤119元
sources.interpretation: Fixed benchmark valuation, not automatic purchase-policy eligibility or the 2020 realized farm-gate price.
Urea is priced per kg product. Water includes pumping; drying is priced per kg actually processed.
4 CNY/kg seed is an explicit benchmark quote; thousand-kernel mass 45 g is a logistical assumption.
Same 2025 Northeast diesel benchmark as the existing farm ledger.

accounting: Reuse owned-machinery OperatingAccounts: consumed seed/urea/fuel/water and actual warehouse drying throughput. No duplicate outsourced service fee, rent, depreciation or ordinary labour charge.
